name: Dispatch Tickets
description:
Dispatch Tickets is the ticketing API for developers and multi-brand organizations — and this connector brings your support tickets into Claude.

Ask Claude to list and search tickets, read the full conversation including internal notes, and check ticket counts by status. Claude can also create and update tickets, post public replies that email the customer, and add private internal notes — every tool is clearly annotated as read-only or write, and the one tool that emails a customer (reply_to_customer) is flagged so you always know when a message leaves your workspace.

It's multi-brand: one connection reaches every brand (workspace) in your Dispatch Tickets organization, and every request is scoped to the brand you choose. You sign in with OAuth and pick which organization to grant access to; Claude only ever acts on that organization's data. No per-seat fees. Learn more at dispatchtickets.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dispatch Tickets to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dispatch Tickets to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dispatchtickets.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dispatch Tickets MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dispatch Tickets provides these MCP tools: add_internal_note, create_ticket, get_ticket, get_ticket_stats, list_brands, list_comments, list_tickets, reply_to_customer, search_tickets, and update_ticket.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dispatch Tickets?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dispatch Tickets in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Dispatch Tickets MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dispatch Tickets requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dispatch Tickets is developed by Dispatch Tickets. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
